question: Which of the following is a qualitative method of credit control?

options.text: Variation in cash reserve ratio of banks

solution:
The correct answer is **__Margin requirement.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Qualitative or Selective Methods:** The methods used by the **central bank to regulate the flow of credit into particular directions** of the economy are called qualitative** methods of credit control**.
 
• These methods affect the economy's composition** rather than the size of the credit.**
 
• The different qualitative **instruments of monetary policy are Marginal requirements.** Regulation of consumer credit. Rationing of Credit.
